summary_1line: Narada, residing in White Island seeking Narayana, performs austere yoga and delivers an extensive hymn praising the deity as the essence of all cosmic forms and principles.

image_candidates.scene_text: Narada stands with arms raised in austere yoga on the radiant White Island, surrounded by luminous white beings while chanting a hymn to Narayana.
The sage Narada bows among moon-bright white inhabitants of the island, their bodies glowing softly in a vast, serene landscape.
A cosmic vision of Narayana encompassing sun, fire, oceans, sacrifices, and countless gods within a single infinite form.
